title: Anti-Israel Protesters Pose a Purity Test That Even Mamdani Can’t Pass
summary: The enmity directed toward Mayor Zohran Mamdani from within the pro-Palestinian movement illustrates the challenge the wider left faces in corralling its insurgents.
